product_one_liner.value: Axure RP is a no-code prototyping and documentation tool for UX designers and product teams to design and communicate interactive software experiences.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing lists Axure RP Pro, Team and Enterprise plans.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in customer stories describing their use of Axure RP.

employee_band.notes: Based on the latest dated count found: 20 employees as of 2026-05-31. Estimates differ; Datanyze reports 38 without a count date.

eng_blog.notes: The blog focuses on product updates, UX guidance and prototyping tips; two qualifying engineer-authored implementation posts were not established.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation includes product reference articles and multiple interactive-prototyping tutorials.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists only Senior Software Engineer, with no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No provider for Axure's own AI features was identified in the reviewed product docs, security/privacy pages, blog or subprocessor list.

compliance_certs.notes: Axure claims SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certification, plus GDPR compliance. The PCI DSS Level 1 statement refers to its payment processor, not Axure itself.

last_funding.notes: ZoomInfo records debt financing with PPP participation on 2020-04-13. Tracxn and Latka otherwise describe Axure as unfunded or bootstrapped; no venture-equity round was identified.

raised_18mo.notes: The reported debt financing dates to April 2020, before the 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09 window; no later round was identified.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists only Senior Software Engineer, with no SDR, BDR or account-executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: On 2026-09-24, Axure introduced an experimental built-in MCP server that gives AI tools access to RP-file pages, widgets, interactions and notes.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No complete dated executive history or qualifying appointment/departure announcement was verified for 2025-11-09 through 2026-11-09.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Axure's subprocessor list identifies HubSpot for email marketing and analytics, and Mailchimp for email marketing.
